description:
** Due to NAVY OPSEC procedures, the vessel name has been redacted from the solicitation. If required to quote, please request the vessel name via email **

NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price Supply-type Purchase Order for Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Point Eight Power, LLC High Voltage Switchboard maintenance and repair on a Brand Name basis.

See attached solicitation posted 13 Mar 2026 for requirements. All respones must be submitted prior to the solicitation closing date on page 1, box 8.
